# Case 06: condition words without an antecedent

Skill: write-introductions, write-methods
Expected gates: G-SH-A, G-INT-18, G-ME-17
Language: zh

Snippet:

> 触发后，系统切换到备用模式，该周期内不再接收新任务，待交接完成后恢复。

Why it fails: no earlier sentence says what is triggered, which period is meant, or what the handover is.
